roles.title: Founding Engineer, Protocol Lead
roles.description: Designed and built a modular interoperability protocol deployed across 150+ chains spanning Ethereum, Solana, Cosmos, Starknet, and more, facilitating over $10B in cross-chain value transfer. Adopted by Aave, Velodrome, Relay, and Renzo.

roles.title: Security Researcher
roles.description: Audited smart contracts across DeFi and Proof of Stake protocols including Eco stablecoin, Symbiotic restaking, and Royco. Reviewed Solidity and Solana programs for security vulnerabilities and incentive flaws.

roles.title: Smart Contract Engineer
roles.description: Designed and built Aera Finance, Gauntlet's first on-chain protocol — a risk-aware treasury management solution adopted by Compound and Uniswap. Manages ~$150M TVL generating ~$5M in annual fee revenue.

roles.title: Partner, Smart Contracts Lead
roles.description: Led smart contract development for stablecoin and identity protocols as code owner on production contracts. Orchestrated DAO governance and established a security-first release process with OpenZeppelin audits and Certora formal verification.

roles.title: Contractor, Protocol Engineering
roles.description: Built the first production implementation of Coinbase Rosetta, enabling exchange accounting, low-level value transfer tracing, and high-security offline staking for Coinbase Custody.

roles.title: Software Engineer, Protocol Engineering
roles.description: Implemented Proof of Stake validator logic and slashing conditions. Optimized oracle exchange rate reporting and contributed privacy-preserving enhancements to the phone number ownership protocol.

roles.title: Founder, President
roles.description: Founded and led 50+ member student organization for blockchain education and development. Organized workshops, hosted Houston Ethereum Meetup, and established industry partnerships.

roles.title: Faculty Instructor
roles.description: Taught two semesters of a full-credit blockchain course at the CoFES Institute alongside Professor Manolo Sanchez of the Jones Graduate School of Business.

roles.title: Student, Computer Science BSE
roles.description: Cum laude, President's Honor Roll. Coursework in Compilers, Operating Systems, High Performance Computing, Secure Cloud Computing, and Formal Methods. Research on using software-defined networks to accelerate distributed consensus.

roles.title: Software Engineer, Blockchain Garage
roles.description: Built the IBM Blockchain Starter Kit, an open-source scaffold for Hyperledger applications with build, test, and deploy tooling for Go and Node.js. Shipped a CLI that streamlined the developer onboarding experience.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description: Built the first Token Curated Registry (adChain), a decentralized whitelist of trusted advertisers for web publishers. Shipped a reusable ERC20 voting standard with partial locking and commit-reveal scheme.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description: Developed Proof of Physical Address, an early smart contract protocol for automated mailing address verification using secrets sent via physical mail.

roles.title: Student, Robotics Lead
roles.description: Led FRC robotics team, implementing PID motor controls and computer vision. Established Java, SolidWorks, and Eagle CAD bootcamps. Honor Roll and National Honors Society.
